_doc: FLEET-MAP-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25: "what really needs to be in the ultra-stable template repo as opposed to these other repos that you created ... it's starting to look like a mess ... create your own instructions and fail-safe ways to make sure it all works together every single time it's deployed for every tenant, any code agent, everything."). One row per repository of the org: what it is for, its layer, what it is copied from (source path, the workflow that copies it, direction), which Workers deploy from it, whether it runs Actions, where it runs (live, equal to what fleetcontract reads from the registries), its visibility and the instruction file an agent reads there. Read by foundation/fleetmap.py: --check (in checks) fails when a repository named in doctrine/tenant-repos.json, doctrine/full-stack.json (seeds of doctrine/seed-deploys.json), github/org-settings.json or session_repos below has no row, when a row is in none of them, and when a synced_from names a path or workflow that does not exist; --drift compares every mirror with its source (a clone beside this checkout, or the public GitHub tree) and reports differ, missing, extra or unmeasured, never ok without a reading; --drift --apply files Q-FLEETMAP-<repo> per mirror that is not equal and closes it when the same reading passes. Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system.

layers.platform: the one repository where code and rules are written; everything else is copied from it or vendors from it
layers.template: a published copy of the platform's seed/ folder, the kernel a new system starts from; never edited by hand
layers.seeded-system: a system started from the kernel; owns its idea, instance and domain content, receives the kernel by sync
layers.tenant: an app the platform runs; owns its app code, vendors named core files
layers.admin: the company's own papers and ledgers; not code
layers.org-profile: the organization's public profile and community defaults

template_contents._doc: TEMPLATE-CODE-ONLY-1: what belongs in ultrastable/seed. It is seed/ of the platform, plus the files in keep. Anything else there is drift: either kernel code to move up into seed/ or a file to delete.

session_repos._doc: Repositories a cloud session of 2026-11-25 had cloned beside the platform; a repository that exists and is in no registry is caught here.

ultrastable/ultrastable.purpose: The platform: all code, rules, doctrine, the website, the dashboard and the seed/ kernel are written here and nowhere else.

ultrastable/seed.purpose: The template a visitor's app repository is created from: a published copy of the platform's seed/ folder and nothing else.
ultrastable/seed.visibility_reason: DISCOVER-1: public by default; github/org-settings.json sets private false

ultrastable/second-tenant.purpose: The first system started from the kernel with no code agent: proof that seed/ alone boots, deploys and runs a system.

ultrastable/ops.purpose: The company's own admin, legal and business papers, backups and sealed audit ledgers; no code deploys from it.
ultrastable/ops.visibility_reason: company admin, legal and backup ledgers (TEMPLATE-CODE-ONLY-1); the one marked exception to DISCOVER-1

ultrastable/.github.purpose: The organization's public profile page and community health defaults.
ultrastable/.github.visibility_reason: GitHub shows an org profile only from a public .github repository

ultrastable/practical-solutions.purpose: Tenant app Practical Solutions (ultrastable.org): evidence-based solutions to global problems.
ultrastable/practical-solutions.deploys_by: its own repository's pipeline (deploy-tenant.yml), not the platform's deploy lane

ultrastable/unlearn.purpose: Tenant app Unlearn: popular beliefs set against the evidence.

ultrastable/what-works.purpose: Tenant app What Works: interventions and what the evidence says they do.

ultrastable/replication-ledger.purpose: Tenant app Replication Ledger: which published findings replicated, across fields.

ultrastable/base-rates.purpose: Planned tenant Base Rates: its repository holds the manifest until its first code.

redundant.evidence: holds only the manifest files that instances/base-rates/ in the core already holds; kept because TENANT-SANDBOX-1 creates a planned tenant's repository before its first code

ultrastable/did-it-work.purpose: Planned tenant Did It Work: its repository holds the manifest until its first code.

redundant.evidence: holds only the manifest files that instances/did-it-work/ in the core already holds; kept because TENANT-SANDBOX-1 creates a planned tenant's repository before its first code

ultrastable/open-questions.purpose: Planned tenant Open Questions: its repository holds the manifest until its first code.

redundant.evidence: holds only the manifest files that instances/open-questions/ in the core already holds; kept because TENANT-SANDBOX-1 creates a planned tenant's repository before its first code

ultrastable/workers.purpose: Retired: the core Worker code moved into the platform under workers/.
ultrastable/workers.visibility_reason: kept public so existing links resolve

redundant.evidence: github/org-settings.json describes it as retired; the code is workers/ in the platform

ultrastable/spec.purpose: Retired: the specifications moved into the platform (specs/, SCOPE.md, licensing/).
ultrastable/spec.visibility_reason: kept public so existing links resolve

ultrastable/license.purpose: Retired: the licence text moved into the platform (LICENSE, licensing/).
ultrastable/license.visibility_reason: kept public so existing links resolve

ultrastable/spinoffs.purpose: Retired: the eight generated apps that shared one Worker; replaced by one repository per tenant.
ultrastable/spinoffs.visibility_reason: kept public so existing links resolve

identity._doc: LIVE-LINKS-1: what a seeded system owns and no sync may overwrite. The kernel sync (foundation/upstream.py OWNED) leaves these alone; the step that fills a new repository from seed/ renders README.md for the system (its own title and Live block) instead of copying the template's.
